name: subagent-started-missing-name-fatal
description: SUBAGENT_STARTED without a name is fatal: the schema requires it, so its absence is a missing required field, not an optional a consumer may fill in
kill: TWO changes, and it takes BOTH — either one alone leaves the other rejecting, and the fixture stays green (verified empirically): (1) make `name` optional on SubagentStartedEventSchema, which is what enforcement rejects on first, AND (2) delete the `typeof (event as { name?: unknown }).name !== "string"` guard in the SUBAGENT_STARTED case of verifyEvents, which rejects it independently of any schema because an in-process producer hands plain objects straight to the verifier. Defaulting the name when absent, in either place, has the same effect and must be done in both.
